subject: Discovery recap: Inference cost pressure & proposed pilot next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finbot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Inference cost pressure & proposed pilot next steps

Alex / Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call so we all have the same priorities and next steps. Let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points
- Inference unit economics are the top constraint: current per-request cost is ~ $0.12 which is unsustainable at your current growth rate.
- Latency spikes on peak traffic (especially 95th pct) impacting user experience for real-time assistants.
- Need a predictable cost model for budgeting/commitments for next quarter.

Current stack / constraints you shared
- Model serving today: AWS SageMaker endpoints on p3 instances (mixed CPU/GPU).
- Session state: Redis for conversation state, DynamoDB for user metadata.
- QPS profile: bursty with sustained periods at ~35 QPS and peaks ~120 QPS.
- Most calls are short chat turns (avg 120-180 tokens output).

Success criteria for a pilot / evaluation
- Reduce per-inference cost by ~3x without measurable degradation in top-line quality.
- P95 latency < 200ms for single-turn chat in your primary US region.
- No regressions on your top 10 evaluation prompts (we'll run your eval set).

Opt-ins / technical preferences
- Open to quantization: you indicated comfort trying INT8; 4-bit is acceptable if we can show equivalent quality on your evals.
- Willing to implement prefix/KV caching and adjust client batching to support server-side batching.
- Need SOC2 and audit log info early in the process (security is a gating item).

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll send a one-page mutual action plan and a short pilot SOW template (attached).
2) You to share: (a) representative logs for 24 hours of traffic (anonymized), (b) your top 10 eval prompts/metrics, (c) expected sustained QPS during pilot.
3) Schedule a 45-min technical kickoff next week (proposed slots below).
4) We’ll run a 2-week pilot focused on cost/latency with a small model variant and report back with unit economics and quality comparisons.

Proposed demo/kickoff slots
- Tue 2026-03-30 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-03-31 13:00-14:00 PT
- Thu 2026-04-01 09:00-10:00 PT

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx (MA plan), call-recording-20260327.mp3 (call audio).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finbot.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@finbot.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Inference cost pressure & proposed pilot next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap, this matches our notes. A few clarifications and answers below.

Confirmations / clarifications
- Current per-request cost of ~$0.12 is accurate (includes compute + Sagemaker infra overhead). Target for us is to get closer to ~$0.04 per request.
- We can share 24 hrs of anonymized logs — will redact PII but include timing/token counts.
- Our top 10 eval prompts are ready, I’ll upload them to the Drive link you shared.

On quantization: we are fine trying INT8; willing to explore 4-bit (4/8-bit) if you provide an eval that shows no more than 1–2% drop in our task-level accuracy.

On batching/caching: engineering is comfortable adding client-side buffering to enable  batch windows of 50–100ms for steady chat traffic. We currently don’t apply prefix caching in our client, so we’ll need guidance on integration points.

Next steps from our side
- I’ll upload logs and evals by Mon 2026-03-29 EOD.
- Please confirm the kickoff slot for Wed 2026-03-31 13:00 PT — that works best for Samir and me.
- We need a ballpark for pilot cost (monthly $) and whether you can support a commit/discount model if we sign a 6–12 month reserved capacity after the pilot.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Product, FinBot
alex.turner@finbot.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finbot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Inference cost pressure & proposed pilot next steps

Perfect — Wed 2026-03-31 13:00 PT is reserved on our side. We’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (kickoff, access/reset expectations, success metrics, security checklist).

Ben — looping you in for pilot economics and SOW.

Alex — a few quick notes about the pilot structure so expectations are aligned:
- Pilot scope: 2 weeks, run on a dedicated test pool in us-west with telemetry enabled. Goal is to compare per-token cost and P95 latency vs your current SageMaker run.
- Deliverables: (1) unit economics report (cost per 1k tokens / per-request), (2) latency distribution and tail analysis, (3) quality regression report vs your eval set.
- If the pilot hits the stated success criteria, we’ll propose a reserved capacity offer with a graduated discount (6/12 month commit options).

We’ll prepare a short checklist for the kickoff and share the MA plan (Drive link) before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finbot.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Inference cost pressure & proposed pilot next steps

Alex — Ben here. Quick welcome and a couple of questions to size the pilot and give you a ballpark.

1) Expected sustained QPS during pilot window? You mentioned ~35 sustained, peaks 120 — is that representative for the 2-week test or should we plan a smaller baseline?
2) Average tokens per turn: you said 120–180 output tokens. Can you confirm average input tokens as well? A couple extra tokens on input can change compute profile.
3) For a back-of-envelope pilot estimate: for a 2-week dedicated test pool targeting your current 35 QPS sustained profile, we’d estimate a pilot cost in the low-to-mid $10k range (this is illustrative — final pricing after we size GPU types and batch/config). If you’re open to a reserved 6–12 month commit, we can discuss a ~25–40% discount depending on commitment size.

I’ll attach the pilot SOW template to the invite; Marissa will loop in our security and solutions folks as needed.

Thanks — excited to run this with you.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0188
